issues.title: [Bug] Project actions menu: Auto-discover dev server runs the first saved action instead of discovering a server

releases.name: v0.2.0
releases.notes:
## What this is

`skill_management` puts a control panel on the skills installed in your OpenCode setup. It can list them, explain why one is unavailable, hide one from the model, and bring it back.

Disabling never touches skill files: it writes a single `skill` permission rule into your global config (`effect: "deny"`, or `"ask"` for a soft disable). Nothing is deleted, moved or rewritten, and removing the rule restores the skill exactly as it was.

| Action | What it does | Writes config |
|---|---|---|
| `list` | Every registered skill with its effective state for the calling agent (`available` / `disabled` / `ask`) | no |
| `inspect` | Why one skill is (un)available: the matching rule, per-agent differences, how its id was derived | no |
| `disable` | Hide it from the model and reject loading it (`effect: "ask"` keeps it listed and asks on load) | yes |
| `enable` | Remove the blocking rule again, whoever wrote it | yes |

Install in one command: `opencode plugin add github:sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management` (details below).

## What's changed since v0.1.0

**Fixed — `list` reported the wrong state.** It merged every agent's permission rules before evaluating them, so deny rules owned by sub-agents (`explorer`, `title`, …) leaked into the caller's result: on a stock setup 28 of 29 skills showed up as `disabled` while `inspect` said they were available. en.headline: sogeisetsu 发布 opencode-skill-management v0.2.0，19 次本人提交并新开 1 个 bug issue
en.summary: Today sogeisetsu made **19 own commits** across three repositories and shipped `v0.2.0` of `sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management`, a control panel that lists, inspects, disables and re-enables OpenCode skills via a single `skill` permission rule rather than touching skill files. The 11 commits in `sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management` covered idempotent CI publishing, a rewritten user-facing README, the `0.2.0` release chore, a new `tools/linux-verify.sh` acceptance script, and real-host verification docs. The 4 commits in `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` added `chrome-devtools-mcp` and `eval-comparison` knowledge entries plus a `MiniMax M3.1 Flash Free` demo. The 4 commits in `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` fixed GFM table rendering in release notes, added wording gates to the daily pipeline, enabled `workflow_dispatch` reruns, and enforced additive phrasing for automated commits, alongside **30 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]`**. sogeisetsu also opened issue #5293 in `openchamber/openchamber` about Auto-discover dev server running the first saved action, and got one reply from `openchamber-bot[bot]` marking it `fix-ready`.

releaseNotes.summary: v0.2.0 adds a control panel for OpenCode-installed skills with four actions: `list`, `inspect`, `disable` and re-enable. Disabling writes a single `skill` permission rule (`effect: "deny"`, or `"ask"` for soft disable) into the global config and never touches skill files, so removing the rule restores the skill exactly.

zh.headline: sogeisetsu 发布 opencode-skill-management v0.2.0，19 次本人提交并新开 1 个 bug issue
zh.summary: 今天 sogeisetsu 在三个仓库提交了 **19 次本人提交**，并发布了 `sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management` 的 `v0.2.0`，这是一个通过单一 `skill` 权限规则来列出、检查、禁用和重新启用 OpenCode 技能的控制面板，不会改动技能文件本身。`sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management` 的 11 次提交涵盖幂等的 CI 发布、重写的面向使用者的 README、`0.2.0` 发布 chore、新增的 `tools/linux-verify.sh` 一键验收脚本，以及真实宿主核验文档。`sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` 的 4 次提交新增了 `chrome-devtools-mcp` 和 `eval-comparison` 知识条目，以及一个 `MiniMax M3.1 Flash Free` 演示。`sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 的 4 次提交修复了 release 正文里 GFM 表格的渲染、为日报流程加入措辞闸门、支持 `workflow_dispatch` 手动补跑，并强制自动提交采用相加式表述，此外另有 **30 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 自动提交**。sogeisetsu 还在 `openchamber/openchamber` 新开 issue #5293，报告 Auto-discover dev server 会运行第一个已保存的 action 而非发现服务器，并收到 `openchamber-bot[bot]` 的一条回复将其标记为 `fix-ready`。

releaseNotes.summary: v0.2.0 为 OpenCode 已安装的技能增加了控制面板，提供 `list`、`inspect`、`disable` 和重新启用四个动作。禁用只会向全局配置写入一条 `skill` 权限规则（`effect: "deny"`，软禁用为 `"ask"`），不删除、移动或改写任何技能文件，移除该规则即可逐字节还原技能。
